name: Minotaur
title: Equipment Master
description: Rounds 1-3: randomly reveals the sizes of 3 Treasures with 6 or more tiles (Prioritizing unknown ones). Rounds 4-5: Randomly reveals the quality of 2 treasures with 6 or more tiles (prioritizing unknown ones).

name: Johnson
title: Base Value
description: When Auction begins, reveals the general locations of white, green, and blue treasures. In round 3 reveals the sizes of all treasures.

name: Harley
title: Precious Vision
description: When Auction begins, reveals the total quantity of purple, gold and red Treasures.

name: Alice
title: Supreme Bloodline
description: When auction begins, reveals the quality of 4 random treasures. At the start of round 3, reveals the quality of 1 random treasure with the highest quality in this auction.

name: Aurora
title: Frozen Mirror
description: When the round 5 begins, reveals the quality of all treasures.

name: Angela
title: Comfort Meal
description: When the auction begins, randomly reveals the sizes of 4 types of treasures. Afterwards, reveals the type of these treasure types each round.

name: Wanwan
title: Tiger's Eye
description: Rounds 1-3 each reveal one detail of 3 Treasures in order: Size, Quality, and Type. At the start of each round, if 2 of the 3 details (size, quality, and type) are known for a treasure, reveals the remaining detail.

name: Vale
title: Updraft
description: Sequentially reveals the quality and size of all gray, green, blue and purple treasures round by round.

name: Layla
title: Random Lock
description: When Auction begins. randomly reveals all information of 3 treasures (Prioritizing unknown ones). Afterwards randomly reveals all information of 1 treasures each round (prioritizing unknown ones).

name: Chou
title: Steady Growth
description: Round 1-4 each reveal one detail of 3 treasures in order: Quality, size, type and all information.

name: Lunox
title: Foresight
description: When auction begins, randomly reveals the quality of 5 treasures(prioritizing unknown ones). Afterwards, randomly reveals the quality of 2 treasures each round(prioritizing unknown ones).

name: Lancelot
title: Noble Family
description: Round 1: reveals the sizes of the treasures in the last row. Round 2: Reveals the quality of the treasures in the last row. round 3 reveals the sizes of treasures in 2 random columns. round 4-5 reveals the type of treasures in 1 of those 2 column.
